instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Organic vineyard and winery producing 60,000 bottles per year. Direct-to-consumer sales through wine clubs account for 45% of revenue. The company faces increasing scrutiny regarding organic certification standards and water usage regulations across various jurisdictions. They operate from centralized production facilities with seasonal distribution points, making logistics and compliance a constant focus.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. This experience highlighted a significant gap between technical capability and structured innovation management.
answers.strategicGoals: We operate in a consolidating market where competitors are merging to gain economies of scale. Our independent position is increasingly vulnerable. We need to proactively strengthen our competitive positioning—either by deepening our specialization in high-margin niches where scale matters less, or by building platform-like switching costs that make our offering stickier for existing customers.
answers.additionalContext: Preparing for Series A in the next 9 months. We need to articulate a clear, credible innovation strategy that differentiates us from competitors in the eyes of VCs. The narrative must tie our innovation investments directly to defensible competitive advantages and revenue growth projections.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Automated Compliance Monitoring Tool (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a low-cost software module that automates the collection and reporting of organic certification data required by high regulatory standards. This addresses immediate operational risk while utilizing existing digital assets.

first_actions: Define minimum viable compliance data set
Select off-the-shelf SaaS platform for tracking documentation
resources_needed: $5,000 for software subscription and implementation consultation
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual compliance reporting hours by 30%
milestones: Q1: Tool MVP completed and tested
Q2: Full integration into existing operational workflow

opportunities.title: Precision Climate Risk Modeling (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Invest in a proprietary AI model that integrates local microclimate data with vineyard management practices to predict specific disease outbreaks or frost risks weeks in advance. This creates a defensible specialization, allowing the company to command premium pricing based on risk mitigation.

first_actions: Identify key data partners for localized weather feeds
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: $20,000 for specialized sensor hardware and model development staff salary (short-term contract)
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful prediction accuracy of frost events >85% within 14 days
milestones: Q4: Pilot deployment in one high-risk vineyard plot

next_steps.action: Formalize the Innovation Pipeline and Budget Allocation Committee (BPC)
Initiate a rapid assessment of supply chain vulnerability using external data partners

key_weaknesses: Low digital maturity hindering scalable product development
High dependence on informal knowledge and key personnel
Fragmented cross-departmental communication regarding technology needs
